videos.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas: I Ran So Fast for So Long. It Was All I Knew
videos.description:
Holding on tight to everything made Priyanka Chopra Jonas successful. It also wore her out.

In this episode, Priyanka Chopra Jonas and Jay Shetty talk about the day she stopped running. She moved fast for a really long time. She used to feel guilty for taking even one day off. Now she loves being the one who picks her daughter up from school.

Priyanka shares the two questions she asks when her mind starts to spiral. She tells the story of the argument with Nick that changed how they talk. And she opens up about the 110 days after her daughter was born at 27 weeks.

Learn why she says thoughts are not facts. And learn what her daughter told her doll that almost made her cancel a flight.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX

videos.description:
Dr. Anna Lembke, MD, is chief of the Addiction Medicine Dual Diagnosis Clinic at Stanford and a leading expert in how to overcome addictions of all kinds. We discuss dopamine dynamics in the brain and how they impact risk-taking, mental obsession, and compulsive behaviors. We also discuss the most common addiction of all—people’s addiction to control—and how prayer and spiritual practices can open up new neural pathways and help end unhealthy thought patterns and behaviors, including codependence.

videos.title: 1,000 days of Duolingo didn't work. So he built his own app with Codex.
videos.description:
William Imoh is the founder of Hackmamba, a developer marketing company, and the creator of Mural, a real-time voice app he built to learn Norwegian after moving from Dubai to Norway. He has a chemical engineering degree, taught himself to code, and spent four years as a product manager, but he had never written a line of Swift. In this episode, William shows how he used Codex and GPT-Live to build Mural natively for iOS and Android, then walks through the Lord of the Rings–themed Grok Bot “fellowship” that helps him run a team of about 25 as a solo founder.

What you’ll learn:
1. The design prompt that made Mural look nothing like any other language app
2. Why 1,000 days of Duolingo left him unable to hold a conversation in Norwegian
3. What GPT-Live-1 costs per session and the latency threshold that makes or breaks a voice tutor
4. How he assigned every solo founder role to a Lord of the Rings character in Grok
5. Why he gave his agents access to everything across 15 open tabs, except one thing
6. What he still has to do himself after the models improved
7. Why the fear that keeps him up isn’t replacement—it’s dependency

*Brought to you by:*
